svg.title: PicoPal circuit by net label
svg.desc: ESP32-C3 SuperMini in the centre. I2C SDA GPIO6 and SCL GPIO7 go to the OLED and VL53L0X; TTP223 output to GPIO4; VL53L0X XSHUT to GPIO3; MAX98357A BCLK GPIO5, LRC GPIO10, DIN GPIO21, SD tied to 3V3, VIN 5V; pan servo signal GPIO20, tilt servo signal GPIO1, both powered from an external 5 V 2 A supply with common ground.

g.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Same net name = same wire. Illustration drawn from the project's pin header; check the silkscreen on your SuperMini clone.
470–1000 µF across EXT5V/GND at the servos.
GND is common to every module and the supply.
